requiredOutcomes: Validate and inspect synthetic installed local-command dependencies through package ID, workflow name, and direct package-directory selection.
Require explicit executionKind, exact registry/lock/digest/identity agreement, a contained executable entrypoint, and accurate host executable/environment requirements.
Reject missing kind, mismatched evidence, unavailable entrypoints, unknown or ambiguous references, unrelated copies, and scope collisions while preserving native/container behavior.
Run focused and host tests, source build, SwiftLint, the six-command installed CLI matrix, and all 75 example validations with complete foreground logs and numeric exits.
Obtain independent implementation review, then commit and push the branch without release or merge.
nonGoals: No migration of legacy YouTube package locks or edits to riela-packages or sibling worktrees.
No schema, registry protocol, resolver framework, execution engine, provider integration, release, or merge change.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Extend the existing installed dependency verifier so one exact verified match supplies the local-command descriptor and canonical executable path; this retains existing identity, integrity, scope, and ownership checks.
Count reference candidates before filtering execution-kind validity so a missing-kind competing lock cannot authorize an ambiguous unqualified reference.
Use the verified canonical executable path in both host requirement and local availability projections; remote hosts independently prove executable and environment capabilities.
Retain Core unresolved-add-on rejection and resolve each reachable callee with its own package context.
intentionalTradeoffs: Keep coupled verifier and host projection edits with one implementation owner; leave documentation and Git finalization to serial reconciliation.
Keep legacy locks without executionKind rejected until their package metadata is explicitly updated.
supportedEdgeCases: Qualified and unique unqualified add-ons, omitted node versions bound to locks, three installed selection modes, and scoped package IDs.
Missing/non-executable/escaping entrypoints, mismatched registry/digest/kind/identity, ambiguity, unrelated copies, and project/user scope conflicts fail closed.
Package and node environments, same-basename executable isolation, remote host capability checks, callee-owned context, and native/container compatibility.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Provider or local-command payload execution and edits to real legacy YouTube package locks.
Authorization by vendor or name alone, automatic migration, and new remote readiness inferred from local files.

acceptanceCriteria: All three installed selection modes validate and inspect with exact canonical executable requirements.
Host capabilities remain accurate; native/container regressions pass.
Focused tests, host tests, source build, SwiftLint, 75 examples and CLI matrix pass with complete logs.
